doc: overrides: our-record ID -> Foundry pack path (relative to packs/pf2e/)
for names the normalizer cannot bridge. Reviewed like code.
waivers: reviewed exemptions for records whose comparison legitimately
differs from ground truth or has no counterpart. Each is bound to the
state_hash of the exact mismatch it excuses (printed by `attest`);
if the mismatch disappears or shifts, `attest` fails until the waiver
is re-reviewed. No Foundry values appear here - reasons are our text.

spec_exclusions.name: Raised by Belief
spec_exclusions.reason: Excluded by name in spec req 1 [call]: its mechanics are parameterized on a deity catalog whose canonical names are ORC-reserved. The spec ships 39 of 40 backgrounds; full breadth deliberately excludes this one.

waivers.reason: Class kits exist only in the book; Foundry ships no class-kit pack. Contents and price semantics hand-verified against AoN (slice-1 dossier section 8.6).

The book parameterizes this background's Lore on the character's home settlement, naming a Golarion city as its example; we ship the generic 'City Lore' per the req-5 ORC scrub, and Foundry encodes no fixed lore for it at all.
The book and AoN print this background's Lore as 'Theater Lore' (Player Core pg. 86); Foundry spells the same Lore with a regional spelling variant. Our record follows the book.
The book and AoN print this background's Lore as 'Gladiatorial Lore' (Player Core pg. 86); Foundry's record carries a misspelled variant of the same Lore. Our record follows the book.

A real PC1 martial-weapons table row (AoN Weapons.aspx?ID=395, Player Core pg. 278): the attack statistics for Striking with a shield. Foundry models shield attacks on the shield records themselves and ships no standalone weapon record, so there is no counterpart.

Foundry attaches its systemic 'consumable' handling trait to every ammunition record and encodes this bundle as negligible bulk; the book's ammunition entry carries no trait line and Bulk L (AoN Weapons.aspx?ID=440, Player Core pg. 280). Our record follows the book on both fields.
Foundry attaches its systemic 'consumable' handling trait to every ammunition record; the book's ammunition entries carry no trait line (PC1 p.280). Trait sets otherwise agree.

The book's Barding table (AoN Equipment.aspx?ID=2778, Player Core pg. 295) prices light barding per size band; Foundry collapses light barding into a single armor-typed record carrying the Small-or-Medium row (matched by gear.barding-light-small-or-medium via the override map) and ships no Large-size counterpart.
AoN indexes this refill row with Bulk L (Equipment.aspx?ID=2720, Player Core pg. 288); Foundry encodes it as negligible bulk. Our record follows AoN/the book.
AoN and the book list Tack at Bulk 1 (Equipment.aspx?ID=2755, Player Core pg. 292); Foundry encodes a heavier bulk. Our record follows the book.
